title: Do AI Coding Assistants Check Before They Install? A Pre-Registered Demand-Side Audit of Trust Signals in the Research Software Supply Chain
abstract: arXiv:2609.07754v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding assistants now select, install, and configure software, and attackers have exploited that position through invented package names, compromised maintainer accounts, and manipulated repository text. In response, the supply-chain community publishes machine-checkable trust signals: software bills of materials, signed releases, build provenance attestations, and declared official channels. Whether coding assistants read or act on those signals has not been measured for any of these classes on research software. We pre-registered and ran a controlled study on six open-source research software projects (three HPC, three quantum computing) drawn from an 87-project corpus, with protocol, seed, panel, and analysis plan deposited with a DOI before any trial. translated_title: AI编程助手在安装前会检查吗？对科研软件供应链中信任信号的预注册需求端审计
translated_abstract: AI编程助手如今能够自主选择、安装和配置软件，而攻击者已利用这一环节，通过捏造包名、入侵维护者账户和篡改仓库文本实施攻击。作为应对，软件供应链社区发布了机器可验证的信任信号：软件物料清单、签名发布版本、构建来源证明以及声明的官方渠道。然而，对于科研软件，AI编程助手是否会读取或依据这些信号采取行动，此前尚未有针对任何信号类别的测量研究。我们预先注册并开展了一项对照研究，研究对象为从87个项目语料库中选取的六个开源科研软件项目（三个高性能计算项目、三个量子计算项目），其协议、随机种子、模型面板和分析计划均在任何试验开始前存档并获得DOI。我们为每个项目创建了九个修改副本：无信号版本、每个信号类别各一个版本、两个带有错误签发者签名或证明的版本、一个包含全部四种信号的版本，以及一个代表……
tldr: 本研究通过预注册的对照审计，首次测量了AI编程助手在安装科研软件时是否会读取并响应机器可验证的供应链信任信号（如软件物料清单、签名发布和构建来源证明）。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered controlled audit provides the first measurement of whether AI coding assistants read and act on machine-checkable supply-chain trust signals (such as SBOMs, signed releases, and provenance attestations) when installing research software.
